applicant.name: Dr. Johanna Steiner
applicant.organisation: Federal Ministry of Health, chronic disease prevention unit (ministry)

purpose: We need regional COPD prevalence to allocate funding for pulmonary rehabilitation places in the next regional structural health plans.
question: How many adults have COPD in each region and what is the prevalence?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
COPD = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with J44.
Prevalence = adults with COPD / all adults in the region × 100, one decimal.
Report per region: adults, adults with COPD and the prevalence.

expected.reason: The purpose is allowed (Art. 53). A health data request is answered only with anonymised statistics; the applicant never sees the data (Art. 69).

judge.why: Rule 3: requested_as is a health data request from a ministry, which may claim a policy-making purpose.
